headline: Homelessness pilot program, Chapter 46 revision for Cannon Plaza, airport leases, and Biddeford Housing Authority TIF/CEA amendment.
summary: Items include the appointment of Laurie Smith as city manager and a homelessness pilot program. Also on the agenda are a Housing Authority TIF/CEA amendment and an executive session on a real estate matter.
